checkedAlternates.risk: Spectacle is one of Aristotle’s six qualitative parts.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Aristotle singles out Spectacle (Opsis) as the least poetic, purely visual element (group-1), separate from Thought, Diction, and Melody (group-3).
Peripeteia, Anagnorisis, Hamartia, and Catharsis are specific tragic mechanisms (group-4), distinct from the six foundational elements (groups 1–3).
